import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    if not data:
        return
    
    idx = 0
    n = int(data[idx])
    idx += 1
    
    dictionary = set()
    for _ in range(n):
        word = data[idx].strip()
        idx += 1
        dictionary.add(word)
    
    q = int(data[idx])
    idx += 1
    
    results = []
    for _ in range(q):
        s = data[idx].strip()
        idx += 1
        
        if len(s) < 2:
            results.append("No")
            continue
        
        found = False
        for i in range(1, len(s)):
            s1 = s[:i]
            s2 = s[i:]
            if s1 in dictionary and s2 in dictionary:
                found = True
                break
        
        results.append("Yes" if found else "No")
    
    for res in results:
        print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
